title: Live websites: a section whose block draws nothing leaves no blank gap

source.ref: Found checking aidentyack.com after Daniel's 2026-11-23 "Make sure that theme is live, fully evolved and in private".

detail: A role block still showing its sample copy draws nothing on a live page when the Space has no real rows (the rule that keeps sample numbers and names off live pages). Its section wrapper (mw-wrap > the padded block div) still rendered, so each hidden block left about 80px of blank padding: aidentyack.com showed big empty bands where offerings, shop and reviews would go. components/sites/website-document.tsx now hides a section whose block wrapper is empty, on every theme. The Aiden Tyack kit's stats band is live: false so a new Space's own count ("1 Members") is not its lead figure; it shows once the owner writes real numbers.
